crossPageConsistencyReview.bookingHandoff: Room counts pass through the query adapter into the standard WhatsApp message. Group form uses actual larger party counts. Outside contact the compact dock starts with one room and no children; on contact it reads and retains the currently edited room preference, room count and children while changing dock dates/adults. Names and notes stay off the URL.
crossPageConsistencyReview.sameRouteContact: Current source uses ContactEnquiry/useSearchParams to pass query.toString() as a BookingForm prop, without a remount key. BookingForm keeps the same form and uncontrolled name/notes fields, hydrates travel preferences in an effect keyed to query/room, and clears stale draft/error feedback when that selection changes. The dock reads current contact form room/count/children instead of replacing them with defaults. Source inspected; root production browser QA is running separately.
crossPageConsistencyReview.nightsScope: StayBar and GroupEnquiry display nights. Contact and dock do not; no universal summary claim.
crossPageConsistencyReview.privacy: Current privacy text accounts for new query preferences, group/company details and dining handoff.
crossPageConsistencyReview.links: Group stays appears in mobile menu, footer and sitemap. Dining PDF href resolves to the existing one-page document.
crossPageConsistencyReview.trust: Google numeric proof carries its check date and external source; exact room capacities, rates, commercial terms and awards remain unclaimed.
crossPageConsistencyReview.verificationLimit: This bounded update inspected current ContactEnquiry, BookingForm and BookingDock source. No browser or UI changes were made; root owns final repeated-dock, field-preservation, accessibility and production checks.
